senses.gloss: In one way or another; in a way not yet known or explained; by some means

(literary) Used, especially at a parting, to express the wish that the outcome of a person's actions be positive for them; typically said to someone who is about to start a journey or a daring endeavour.
The nocturnal, insectivorous, burrowing mammal Orycteropus afer, of the order Tubulidentata and somewhat resembling a pig. Common in some parts of sub-Saharan Africa.
A short novel or long short story.
Specifically, a small amount of time.
To a small extent or degree.
To a limited extent or degree; not completely.
A small amount; a little bit.
A worldwide network of militant Sunni Islamic organizations and individuals.
A girl who behaves in a typically boyish manner.
Modeling clay for children.
Permitted, authorized. [from 16th c.]
history: period of time seen as coherent entity
An interval of time.
A male parent, especially of a human; a male who parents a child (which he has sired, adopted, fostered, taken as his own, etc.).
A father, a male parent.
(colloquial) Father, papa.
Father.
A holy man, a spiritual leader.
A strong vertical post of timber or iron, fixed to a wharf, dock, or the deck of a ship, to which the ship's mooring lines or towlines are secured.
Serranus cabrilla, the gaper, a fish found in European waters.
Exhibiting intellectual knowledge, such as that found in books.
Endowed with intellect; having a keen sense of understanding; having the capacity for higher forms of knowledge or thought; characterized by intelligence or cleverness
Smart, intelligent, or witty; mentally quick or sharp.
Of acute discernment; having keen insight; mentally perceptive.
A ridge or hill of ice in an ice field.
The female of a pair of mated animals.
The male of a pair of animals.
Someone or something with similar claims of quality or distinction as another.
A person in a marriage or marital relationship.
A companion; a match; an equal.
A woman who lives with a man, but who is not a wife.
The placenta and other material expelled via the birth canal following childbirth or parturition in mammals.
To move around the general vicinity of something.
A script for a story to be produced as a radio show, such as a radio drama.
Deceased, dead.
Vaccinium myrtillus, the wild European blueberry of the cowberry family.
The relative darkness or lightness of a color in (a specific area of) a painting etc.
(language, dated) A whining style of speaking; a kind of mournful or artificial strain of voice; an affected speaking with a measured rhythm and a regular rise and fall of the voice.
various units of mass notionally equivalent to a tun
A permanent mark on the skin, sometimes caused by the healing of a wound.
A ceremony to honor and remember a deceased person, often distinguished from a memorial service by the presence of the body of the deceased.

(Ireland) An evening funeral ritual in which the coffin holding the deceased is brought, usually from a funeral home, to the church where the funeral mass will be celebrated the following day. Prayers are said before and after the journey, after which mourners are typically received at the home of the deceased.
established organisation
A regular patron of a place or institution; a person constantly present at a certain place.
Fine black or dull brown particles of amorphous carbon and tar, produced by the incomplete combustion of coal, oil etc.
response
A written or spoken response; part of a conversation.
Hard cash in the form of banknotes and coins, as opposed to checks, credit cards, or credit more generally.
Money in the form of notes or bills and coins, as opposed to checks, credit or electronic transactions.
A small towel, hand or face wipe, either dry or more commonly impregnated with water or a cleansing fluid.
(British) The living room or sitting room of a house.
The living room of a house, or a room for entertaining guests; a room for talking; a sitting-room or drawing room.
Standing in relation or connection.
Related, connected, or pertinent to a topic.
A combination of water and other substance(s).
Urine.
Liquid waste consisting of water, salts, and urea, which is made in the kidneys, stored in the bladder, then released through the urethra.
A wide, open space that is used to grow crops or to hold farm animals, usually enclosed by a fence, hedge or other barrier.
An area to cultivate: a field
The most populous state of the United States. Capital: Sacramento. Largest city: Los Angeles.

The electrical device gradually developed in the early 19th century to transmit messages (telegrams) using Morse code; the entire system used to transmit its messages including overhead lines and transoceanic cables.
A message transmitted by telegraph.
Resentful desire of something possessed by another or others (but not limited to material possessions).
jealous attitude (e.g. fear of infidelity)
Bread that has been toasted (cooked lightly by browning).
A small board with keys primarily used for tactile input into a machine.
(video games, trademark) A video game console of the "PlayStation" brand.
unit of measure

(automotive, trucking, heavy equipment) A device, usually an assembly of gears (gearbox) plus a clutch or torque converter, through which power is sent from the engine to the driveshaft in an automobile (motor car or motor truck).
That part of a car's transmission containing the train of gears, and to which the gear lever is connected.
homosexual — see also homosexual, lesbian
An implement consisting of multiple more or less flexible bristles or other filaments attached to a handle, used for any of various purposes including cleaning, painting, and arranging hair.
A kitchen implement for mixing.
Not requiring the use of a hairbrush, scrubbing brush, or other brush.
(slang) A helicopter.
To preach, to berate, to scold.
To chide or scold vehemently.
To chastise or punish physically or verbally; to scold with abusive language.
Epinephrine, the hormone and neurotransmitter.

A catecholamine hormone and neurotransmitter; as a hormone, secreted by the adrenal gland in response to stress (when it stimulates the autonomic nervous system); as a neurotransmitter, synthesized from norepinephrine. It is also used as a medication.
musical form
Any mammal of the many rodent families (especially Muridae) that have a small body and a long tail.
A medium-sized rodent belonging to the genus Rattus.
A container.
The bags and other containers that hold a traveller's belongings.
An assistant member of a criminal gang.
Pleased; happy; gratified.
Showing inventiveness or originality; witty.
In public, openly, in an open and public manner.
Openly and without reservation.
In a straightforward manner; straightforwards; straightforwardly.
In an overt manner; publicly; openly.
Any natural satellite of a planet.
An underground prison or vault, typically built underneath a castle.
The symbol "‐", typically used to join two or more words to form a compound term, or to indicate that a word has been split at the end of a line.
The skilled practice of a practical occupation.
The fact of knowing about something; general understanding or familiarity with a subject, place, situation etc.
A capacity to do something well; a technique, an ability, usually acquired or learned, as opposed to abilities that are regarded as innate.
A daring or dangerous feat, often involving the display of gymnastic skills.
A readiness in performance; aptness at doing something.
The ability to solve difficult problems in original, clever, and inventive ways; ingeniousness.
A trick or device used to attain some end.
Something clever, or done cleverly.
A seller of flour.
A forest or grove of pine trees, either natural or as a plantation.
An optical instrument used for observing small objects.
Lacking respect; not having or not showing respect for or seriousness towards something that is usually treated with respect; going against conventional precepts.
Moving with a slow pace or motion; not swift.
An act of shifting; a slight movement or change.
An expert on mathematics; someone who studies mathematics.
The soft fruit borne by this shrub, formed of a black (when ripe) cluster of drupelets.
Any thorny shrub.
The capital and largest city of Montenegro.
A process of social and economic change whereby a human society is transformed from a preindustrial to an industrial state.
A monoamine C₈H₁₁NO₂ that is a decarboxylated form of dopa, present in the body as a neurotransmitter and a precursor of other substances including adrenalin.
A city in Syria.

A dish of ground meat (usually made from ground beef, although lamb, pork, veal, venison, poultry and seafood are also used) formed into a loaf shape, mixed with egg and breadcrumbs, then baked or smoked, and usually served in slices.
A public building or room for gambling.
Any of the fungi of the genus Cordyceps, a genus of endoparasitoid sac fungi.
A sharp, pointed, two-edged surgical instrument used in venesection and for opening abscesses etc.
A small straight knife with a very sharp blade used for surgery, dissection and craftwork.
The yield of harvesting, i.e., the gathered crops or fruits.
A circumstance in which a choice must be made between two or more alternatives that seem equally undesirable.
A dilemma, a difficult decision or choice.
To remove sensitive or personal data from (a database or file).
Marked with a date.
Obsolete.
A term of friendly address, regardless of feelings.
One of a group of five, particularly babies born from the same mother during the same birth.
(Internet) The totality of blogs, especially the unique jargon, cultures and shared interests created by their interconnection. [1999]
A name for an inhabitant or native of a specific place, usually derived from the name of the place.
Intense pleasure.
A short prayer of redemption; I seek forgiveness from Allah; God forgive me.
An athletics event in which the runners have to run 3000 metres round a track, jumping hurdles and a water obstacle along the way.
A stupid person.
(transitive) To make a show of; to put on a pretense of; to feign; to assume. To make a false display of. [from 16th c.]
To submit (a physical object) to a court as evidence.
To play a role; to depict a character, person, situation, or event.
(intransitive) To believe (something is reasonable) and argue (for it); to advocate.
To bring up as a subject for debate.
(transitive) To pretend to be (a different person); to assume the identity of, especially when there is an intent to deceive.
(transitive) To bring forward or offer, as an argument, passage, or consideration which bears on a statement or case; to cite; to allege.
A universal consensus among fuqaha (Sunni legal scholars) on a point of law; one of the sources of Sunni jurisprudence.
Any of species Triticum dicoccum, one of a group of hulled wheats that are important food grains.
(military) A bombproof chamber, usually of masonry, in which cannon may be placed, to be fired through embrasures; or one capable of being used as a magazine, or for quartering troops.
A person who makes manual copies of works such as manuscripts or paintings.
An acute, infectious, febrile disease of both humans and animals, caused by spirochetes of the genus Leptospira.
Any rod-shaped, gram-positive bacterium, of the genus Listeria, especially those responsible for the bacterial infection listeriosis.
A mournful or plaintive poem; a funeral song; a poem of lamentation.
(obsolete) The process of conveying something.
(countable, sports) The act of moving (with) a ball by kicking or bouncing it.
Food, especially convenience snack foods.
Provisions, money, or other supplies given to someone setting off on a long journey.
Any of a group of deadly organophosphate nerve agents developed by the Soviet Union in the 1970s and 1980s to evade restrictions on chemical weapons.
A park where visitors can see marine mammals and/or fish.
A banded variety of chalcedony, a cryptocrystalline form of quartz.
An act of rubbing.
Marked by pessimism and little hopefulness; expecting the worst.
Someone who habitually expects the worst outcome; one who looks on the dark side of things.
In a haphazard manner; in a random, chaotic, and incomplete manner.
(molecular biology) A self-propagating misfolded conformer of a protein that is responsible for a number of diseases that affect the brain and other neural tissue.
The chemical element (symbol Ra) with an atomic number of 88. It is a soft, shiny and silvery radioactive alkaline earth metal.
What somebody or something is known for.
Having the same name as another (i.e., like a namesake).
word with the same sound or spelling
words with the same pronunciation
The capital city and raion of the Autonomous Republic of Crimea, Ukraine and capital city of the Republic of Crimea, Russia.
A thyroid hormone, with the chemical formula C₁₅H₁₁I₄NO₄, that regulates cell metabolism and growth.
A country and archipelago of Polynesia in Oceania. Capital and largest city: Funafuti.
A mode of employment in which sets of workers are rotated to maintain a continuous 24/7 operation, usually, with a system of three eight-hour shifts: first shift, second shift, and third shift.

A female fictional character from non-live-action visual media (typically an anime, manga, or video game) or non-fictional persona to whom one is romantically attracted and/or whom one considers one's wife.
The presumed cause, force, principle, or divine will that predetermines events.
(transitive) To cut a notch in (something).
Light rain.
Itchy, swollen, red areas of the skin which can appear quickly in response to an allergen or other conditions.
A transport system using rails used to move passengers or goods.
